item.title: Unit 5 Reflectionblog
item.description:
UNIT 5 REFLECTION

I would like to write my reflection blog of Unit 5 about the presentation by Group no. 4, which was about the experiences of women in the field of computer science. Among all nine presentations, this was the one that I found interesting. They discussed the history where there were many contributions of women in various fields of computer science, and also explained how these are dominated now by men. Their way of presenting the topic was more attention-grabbing. They also discussed the challenges faced by women in computing-related fields. They explained how society and culture have an influence on women emerging in computing.

item.title: Unit 4 reflection blog
item.description:
UNIT 4 REFLECTION

Working with the two projects felt really interesting as it was different from what we usually do in our lab sessions. The most interesting part was us exploring the tools on our own without any provided guidelines. At first, I thought that working alone would be hard, but the process was really interesting as we could go through most of the features possible of the tool. And I think that working with proper guidelines would not give us as much fun as we had because if there are guidelines, we would only explore the mentioned features of the tool rather than exploring as a whole as we did.

item.title: Unit 3 Reflectionblog
item.description:
UNIT 3 - REFLECTION

Unit 3 was a bit different compared to Unit 1 and 2. It helped me understand about failures. The readings and case studies assigned for us made me understand more about how mistakes and failures happen. It helped me understand that failures are not random events but are results of so many small mistakes.

I also learned that small mistakes should be taken into concern so that big failures could be avoided. The readings contained so many examples which explained how these small mistakes are resulting into major failures.

item.title: Unit 2 Reflection Blog
item.description:
UNIT 2 - REFLECTION

Unit 2 was difficult as well as an interesting unit. The most interesting session of the unit was learning about images. This session helped us know more on how an image is represented in computers and how to calculate the memory required to store an image as well as videos. The idea that the range of colours having different intensity values which is represented with numbers was a new learning for me from the unit. And further, the labs helped me more on understanding the concept better. Through labs we also learned how different filters such as rotations, reflections and translations work on images.

item.title: Unit 1 Reflection Blog
item.description:
UNIT 1 - REFLECTION

The Unit 1 felt quite easy compared to Unit 2. My understanding about data and information changed as we went through DIKW model. Earlier I thought data and information shares somewhat the same idea, but as we discussed in DIKW model, the raw data is getting processed to information. Further, the activities conducted in class such as the census of bangalore helped me study about the interpretation of data in real life.

item.title: My First Post
item.description:
REFLECTION BLOG

Hello Everyone,

Mahitha here! I am a student at Azim Premji University. I am doing my major in BSc Information Science. I am writing this blog to reflect on my classroom discussions and also share some of my learning experiences.

I am a person who loves to learn new things, but at sometimes, i feel nervous when it comes to learning technical subjects like information science. But my strong will for not giving up, helps me in understanding the subject step by step.
